title: Transfer of approximate tangent planes across sets with zero-density symmetric difference (proof of Simon 1.6 ⇒)
statement: Let C, N ⊆ ℝ^Q be Hⁿ-null-measurable, y ∈ ℝ^Q and T a linear subspace of ℝ^Q. Assume T is the (unweighted, Def. 1.4) approximate tangent space of N at y, Hⁿ(N ∩ B̄_r(y)) < ∞ for some r > 0, and Hⁿ((C ∖ N) ∩ B̄_ρ(y))/ENNReal.ofReal(ρⁿ) → 0 and Hⁿ((N ∖ C) ∩ B̄_ρ(y))/ENNReal.ofReal(ρⁿ) → 0 in [0, ∞] as ρ → 0+. Then T is the approximate tangent space of C at y.
lean_statement: ∀ (Q n : ℕ) (C N : Set (Eucl Q)) (y : Eucl Q) (T : Submodule ℝ (Eucl Q)), NullMeasurableSet C (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) → NullMeasurableSet N (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) → Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n N y T → (∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) (N ∩ closedBall y r) < ∞) → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) ((C \ N) ∩ closedBall y ρ) / ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) ((N \ C) ∩ closedBall y ρ) / ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n C y T
